answer: Make reputation a non-transferable relic minted only after a long voyage: a key must answer and grade honestly for 30 consecutive epochs before its rewards unlock, and any missed epoch resets the clock. Graders are dealt at random, so a farm of N keys pays N full workloads for a month before earning anything, while pairwise agreement checks flag keys that always score alike and slash their bonds. Reaching the summit of voting power costs sustained, separate labor per identity.
